Subject: Alexander Hamilton as performed by original Broadway cast member Lin-Manuel Miranda. Use reference 1 for his dark slicked-back hair tied into a short ponytail, warm light-medium complexion, narrow long face, brown eyes and small connected mustache/goatee; reference 2 shows him center-right wearing his blue Continental coat with long buff lapels and cuffs, brass buttons, cream waistcoat, white stock and ruffled jabot. Preserve this blue-and-buff Act I costume silhouette and his recognizable original-cast appearance in a newly drawn interpretation.
Style/medium: Polished feature-animation 3D realism. Natural skin and cloth texture with gently simplified face, realistic proportions, expressive but naturally sized eyes; sophisticated cinematic animated film rendering.
Composition: a single waist-up character, from hair top to upper hips, vertical 2:3 portrait at high resolution. Three-quarter torso facing slightly viewer right, looking attentively toward the viewer right. Neutral attentive relaxed closed-mouth expression. Elbows and all hair fully inside frame, arms resting naturally down, no props. Leave a small even margin above head and beside both elbows.
Lighting: scene-independent soft neutral key light from front-left, gentle fill, no colored stage spill, no rim glow.
Background: genuine transparent alpha channel, isolated clean silhouette. No scenery, floor, card, white rectangle, or checkerboard baked into image. No environment, text, labels, watermark, microphone, extra characters. Do not photopaste.
